Selection controls

Each one wraps a real input, hidden but still focused, checked and submitted by the browser. The visible indicator is drawn beside it, so keyboard and form behavior comes for free.

Checkboxes

Zero or more choices from a set. Each one stands on its own.

Laid out in a row

Indeterminate

A parent checkbox showing that some, but not all, of its children are checked. The state is set in script — there is no HTML attribute for it.

Radio buttons

Exactly one choice from a set. Everything sharing a name forms one group, which the arrow keys then move through.

Delivery speed

In a row

Switches

For a setting that takes effect immediately. If the change only applies after a Save button, use a checkbox instead.

Toggle chips

A compact multi-select, usually for filtering a list that is visible at the same time.

Filter

Single choice

Choice cards

When each option needs more than a line of explanation, give it a whole surface. The entire card is the hit area.

Selection in lists

A checkbox in the leading slot turns a list into a multi-select.

Choosing between them

ControlChoicesAppliesUse when
CheckboxZero or moreOn submitOptions are independent and the form is saved as a whole.
RadioExactly oneOn submitTwo to five options that all need to stay visible.
SelectExactly oneOn submitMore options than fit comfortably as radios.
SwitchOn or offImmediatelyA setting that takes effect the moment it is flipped.
Toggle chipZero or moreImmediatelyFiltering a list shown on the same screen.
Choice cardOne or moreOn submitEach option needs a paragraph to explain it.
